aomAtlanteanGeneralRumor0.text: They say there is a god power that takes an enemy war machine apart backwards into a heap of parts, but it is no use at all against the living.

aomAtlanteanGeneralRumor1.text: My cousin says he saw someone plant a tree of golden apples on a battlefield. Hamadryads guarded it, and his own troops caught their breath every single round.

aomAtlanteanGeneralRumor2.text: I hear some can make a Tartarian Gate push up out of the ground. When it opens, everything around it gets singed, friend and foe alike, and things come crawling out of it.

aomAtlanteanGeneralRumor3.text: If you see everything in the middle of the field being sucked towards one point, send in your flyers and your level 7 giants at once. That trick does not work on them.

aomAtlanteanGeneralRumor4.text: There is a trap the enemy cannot see once it is buried. Whoever steps on it gets dragged down by a great spider and can hardly move for a good while.

aomAtlanteanGeneralRumor5.text: They say the one who wears the golden crown of battlements is never short of money, and his soldiers are in unusually high spirits.

aomAtlanteanGeneralRumor6.text: Bring the seven things the Titans left behind together and they fuse into a disc by themselves, but once joined they can never be taken apart again.

aomAtlanteanGeneralRumor7.text: Someone picked up two torches of cold fire at a three-way crossroads. Ever since, the god powers he casts often sound a second time.

aomAtlanteanGeneralRumor8.text: A sailor told me of a hide whose eye markings turn to follow people. Whoever wears it sees farther than anyone else.

aomAtlanteanGeneralRumor9.text: They say that once the Echo of Atlantis is fully mastered, six god powers out of ten sound once more, though the second time carries only half the force.
